Frequently Asked Questions

What is Pocket Locker?

Pocket Locker – Private Vault is designed to help you organize important personal information such as documents, photos, notes, passwords, certificates, and IDs in one private place.

Can I use Pocket Locker offline?

Yes. Pocket Locker is designed with offline access in mind, allowing normal vault usage without requiring an internet connection.

How can I protect my vault?

Pocket Locker supports PIN protection and biometric authentication on supported devices.

How does backup work?

Pocket Locker provides backup and restore functionality. Follow the backup instructions inside the app and make sure you have access to the selected backup location before restoring.

What should I do if I forget my PIN?

For security reasons, access to a protected vault may depend on the recovery options available in the app. Contact support if you need assistance.

Getting Help

When contacting support, please describe the problem clearly and include your device model, operating system version, Pocket Locker app version, and the steps that caused the issue.

Please do not send passwords, PINs, verification codes, Aadhaar numbers, bank account details, or other sensitive personal information by email.

Feedback & Bug Reports

We welcome feedback that helps us improve Pocket Locker. If you find a bug, please include what happened, what you expected to happen, and steps to reproduce the issue.
